\section[bolshóy]{\ru{большой} (bolshóy) — big}

\label{lesson:RU-C65-big}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ru{большой}}
\textbf{\ru{большой}} (\emph{bolshóy}) — \textquotedblleft{}big\textquotedblright{}.

One more word for big, small, old, long, short.
\end{grammarlens}
